content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD SUBROUTINE STATISTICS (L63-L180, header @L57, 05/06/2010 Fengyan Shi; BSD header L12-L55) plus SUBROUTINE CHECK_STATISTICS (L182-L198). STATISTICS (USE GLOBAL @L64, USE TIDE_MODULE @L65): over the interior (Jbeg:Jend, Ibeg:Iend) accumulates MassVolume=SUM(Eta*DX*DY) where MASK>0 (L88-L90; reference comment 'Vol=SUM(Eta*dx*dy), reference is at z=0' @L85) and Energy=SUM(0.5*g*H^2*dx*dy + 0.5*(u^2+v^2)*H*dx*dy) (L92-L94, formula comment @L86); computes MaxEta/MinEta/MaxU/MaxV via MAXVAL/MINVAL/ABS (L98-L101); finds the maximum speed Utotal=SQRT(U^2+V^2) on wet cells and the local phase speed Fr=SQRT(GRAV*Max(H,MinDepthfrc)) at that point (L104-L114), fallback Fr=SQRT(GRAV*MinDepthfrc) if never set @L115; MPI_ALLREDUCEs the eight scalars (SUM for MassVolume/Energy L117-L120; MAX for MaxEta/MaxU/MaxV/UTotalMax/Fr L121-L132; MIN for MinEta L123-L124); rank 0 prints a STATISTICS block to stdout (L138-L148) and log unit 3 (L150-L160) with FORMAT 101 (6E12.4) @L163, including TIME/DT, the six field scalars, UTotalMax, Fr, Froude number UTotalMax/Fr, wet-dry mass Dmass, and the four tide boundary levels when any Tide side is active (L145-L148, L157-L160); rank 0 then CALLs CHECK_STATISTICS on each printed quantity (L167-L176). CHECK_STATISTICS(val) (L182-L198): IF(ISNAN(val)) writes 'NaN detected in statistics, stopping simulation!' to stdout and unit 3 (L190-L191) and calls MPI_ABORT(MPI_COMM_WORLD,9,ier) @L193 then STOP @L194. L201-L203 blank.
entities: SUBROUTINE STATISTICS @L63-L180; USE GLOBAL @L64; USE TIDE_MODULE @L65; IMPLICIT NONE @L66

locals: REAL(SP)::MassVolume,Energy,MaxEta,MinEta,MaxU,MaxV,Fr,UTotal,UTotalMax,MaxM all initialized =ZERO @L68-L70; REAL(SP)::MassVolume0 @L71; LOGICAL::FirstCallStatistics=.TRUE. @L72 with SAVE FirstCallStatistics @L73; REAL(SP)::myvar @L74; FORMAT label 101 @L163

params_defined.name: FirstCallStatistics
params_defined.default: .TRUE. (SAVEd; never referenced after declaration in this file)

equations.ref: speed at wet cells; max tracking @L108-L109
phase speed at max-speed location; fallback IF(Fr==ZERO)Fr=SQRT(GRAV*MinDepthfrc) @L115; printed Froude = UTotalMax/Fr @L144/@L156

io.name: STATISTICS block: header @L138, ' TIME        DT' @L139, values WRITE(*,101) Time,DT @L140, field scalars @L141-L142, ' MaxTotalU   PhaseS      Froude      WetDryMass' @L143, values @L144, tide levels @L146-L147 (guard @L145)

calls: call MPI_ALLREDUCE: MassVolume(MPI_SUM) @L117, Energy(MPI_SUM) @L119, MaxEta(MPI_MAX) @L121, MinEta(MPI_MIN) @L123, MaxU(MPI_MAX) @L125, MaxV(MPI_MAX) @L127, UTotalMax(MPI_MAX) @L129, Fr(MPI_MAX) @L131
CALL CHECK_STATISTICS on MassVolume @L167, Energy @L168, MaxEta @L169, MinEta @L170, MaxU @L171, MaxV @L172, UTotalMax @L173, Fr @L174, UTotalMax/Fr @L175, Dmass @L176 (rank 0 only, guard @L165)
CALL MPI_ABORT( MPI_COMM_WORLD , 9 , ier) @L193; STOP @L194; ISNAN(val) @L189
unresolved: Fr after MPI_ALLREDUCE(MPI_MAX) @L131-L132 is the maximum phase speed across ranks, not the phase speed at the location of the global UTotalMax — the printed Froude number UTotalMax/Fr (L144, L156) mixes extrema from different ranks (cross-line L108-L110 vs L129-L132)
Energy accumulation (L92-L94) is not MASK-guarded, unlike MassVolume (L88-L90) — dry cells contribute 0.5*g*H^2 terms

NaN check runs only on rank 0 (guard @L165) on the already-reduced values, and MPI_ABORT @L193 is called from rank 0 only — hang risk if other ranks are inside a collective is not addressed in this file; ISNAN is a compiler extension

MassVolume0 @L71, MaxM @L70, FirstCallStatistics @L72-L73 declared/initialized but never used afterwards in this file; locals initialized in declarations (L68-L70) acquire implicit SAVE, though L78-L80 re-zeroes the accumulators each call (MaxEta/MinEta/MaxU/MaxV/Fr are fully overwritten @L98-L115)
Dmass (wet-dry mass, printed @L144/L156 and NaN-checked @L176) is computed elsewhere — not updated in this file
